summary: Iteration 12 — tested new 'Bandingkan Penawaran' (bid compare) feature end-to-end. Backend: new pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12.py with 6 cases, all pass (6/6). Verified GET /api/custom/projects/{id} bids now include `vendor_verified` (bool) alongside vendor_rating/vendor_review_count/vendor_top_rated for every bid when viewer is client or admin, and also for vendor's own bid; verified bids sorted by amount asc; verified accept + m1 pay flow still works and losing bids become 'rejected'; verified cannot-accept-after-awarded (400). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080 & 390x844): created a TEST project with 4 bids via 4 VERIFIED vendors (demo supplier + demo designer + 2 ad-hoc verified vendors inserted via Mongo + session cookie). Client-viewer sees 4 `bid-compare-{bid_id}` checkboxes. compare-bar hidden initially; after 1 select bar appears with compare-open DISABLED and 'pilih min. 2' hint; selecting 3 disables the 4th checkbox (max-3 enforced); compare-clear resets state and hides bar. compare-dialog opens via compare-open: 3 compare-col-{bid_id} columns rendered, rows for Harga Total, DP 30%, Durasi, Rating+ulasan, Top Rated, Verifikasi (green 'Terverifikasi' for all 4), Item RAB, Spesifikasi, Catatan. data-best=true correctly applied to cheapest amount cell, fastest duration cell, and highest rating cell (PT Material Nusantara 4.9 beats Studio Ruang Arsitek 4.5 and new vendor 0). compare-accept-{bid_id} with window.confirm (auto-accepted) triggered the real accept + m1/pay flow — success toast 'Pemenang dipilih & DP 30% ditahan di Escrow MatShop' shown; project transitioned to awarded then in_progress (because m1 pay also fires), m1 status=held, vendor_id = chosen vendor; after refresh checkboxes disappear (canCmp=false since status!=open). Mobile 390px: no page horizontal overflow; compare dialog uses overflow-x-auto with min-w-[640px] table — scrollable as intended.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful compare-accept + award, the local `cmp` selection state is not reset, so the floating `compare-bar` ('N penawaran dipilih · Bandingkan (N)') remains visible until the next 20s poll re-renders without checkboxes (checkboxes themselves do disappear immediately). Users could re-open the dialog with stale selections; clicking compare-accept inside the dialog in that state would hit backend 400. Minor UX glitch — recommend calling setCmp([]) and setShowCmp(false) inside accept() after success.

action_items: Clear `cmp`/`showCmp` state after a successful accept() in CustomProjectDetail.jsx so the floating compare-bar vanishes immediately post-award.
critical_code_review_comments: BidCompare.jsx `bestOf` uses Math.min(...bids.map(...)) with the comparing array — fine for 2–3 items, but if only 1 bid is ever rendered (shouldn't happen because `canCmp` requires bids.length>1) it would still work. No concern.

CompareDialog ROWS table render uses `key && best[key](b)` — for rows without `key` (DP 30%, Lencana, Verifikasi, Item RAB, Spesifikasi, Catatan) `data-best` becomes `undefined` which React omits — expected.

CustomProjectDetail: compare state not cleared after accept (see ui_bugs). Also, when the auto-poll (`setInterval(load, 20000)`) returns after award, user's selected `cmp` ids may still match now-rejected bids — dialog would then render those (status rejected shown in BidCard as 'Tidak dipilih' chip, but compare-accept button still renders). Mitigated by backend 400 but worth guarding client-side.
custom_projects.get_project: `verified` dict builds a second Mongo query — fine, but could be merged with the `reviews.badges` fetch. Not blocking.
BidCompare max-6xl dialog width is good at desktop; on tablets 768px (iPad) the 3-column table may feel cramped but overflow-x-auto handles it.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flow (checkbox limit, bar enable/disable, clear, dialog columns, data-best highlights, accept->award+m1 held, checkboxes disappear, mobile no overflow). 1 LOW ui glitch (bar not auto-cleared after award).

test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo with role in {contractor_buyer, supplier_vendor, designer_creator, admin}. Extra VERIFIED vendors created via direct Mongo insert (see test file).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST custom project CP-060580A5 'TEST UI Iter12 Compare' now in 'in_progress' (vendor=user_demo_supplier, m1 held). 2 ad-hoc TEST verified vendors (test-cmp-A-*, test-cmp-B-*) were created in users+user_sessions and deleted at teardown via mongosh. Backend test fixtures create their own TEST project each run and mark it cancelled on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compare feature testids: bid-compare-{bid_id} (on BidCard, only when viewer=client+status=open+bids>1, disabled when 3 selected and this one not checked); compare-bar (floating, visible when cmp.length>0, text includes 'pilih min. 2' when n<2); compare-open (disabled n<2); compare-clear; compare-dialog; compare-table; compare-col-{bid_id} (one per selected); compare-amount-{bid_id} / compare-duration-{bid_id} / compare-rating-{bid_id} each with data-best true|false; compare-accept-{bid_id} triggers window.confirm then accept+pay m1. Backend addition: get_project returns vendor_verified bool per bid. Note that after a successful award the local cmp state isn't cleared — pending fix. All previous iter8-11 features untouched.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works. Minor UX note: in CustomProjectDetail.jsx line ~38 `accept()`, after `toast.success(...)` and before `load()`, add `setCmp([]); setShowCmp(false);` to clear floating compare-bar on successful award.
